title: Binomials
prompt:
**Problem.** Line 1: q. Each line: n r. Print C(n, r) mod
1e9+7.

**Constraints:** 1 ≤ q ≤ 200000; 0 ≤ r ≤ n ≤ 10^6.

Factorial + inverse-array precompute; per-query Pascal is the trap.

tests.name: small
half of 50
load: 7 binomials at n = 1e6
